==Bundles==
Tigerseye is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Tigerseye is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Tigerseye is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Dark Striped Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt194b.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

Tigerseye is not used in any [[quests]].
